flags.summary: At an Oct. 28, 2024 special meeting, then-board president John Wallace said Scott had violated the board's code of ethics policy by endorsing two candidates in the 2024 District 1 race during the board's Oct. 2, 2024 meeting. Scott read an apology, said 'My opinion wasn't needed and I violated our Code of Ethics Policy,' gave up his $500 fourth-quarter stipend and asked to be replaced as vice president; David Storie was elected vice president for the rest of 2024.
flags.note: Self-imposed penalties after the board president cited a policy violation; no formal censure vote was reported. Scott remains a board member and is seeking reelection.
